summary: Reviewed ce11cdf with Opus in the foreground and fixed what it found. slot_open now checks out the right branch after another lane's failed open, marks a slot that can't be checked out needs-<m> instead of letting the loop spin, and keeps ~ global excludes. A passed default lane no longer blocks later lanes. entry.json is taken back under the record lock. Weak checks strengthened.
verified_how: The three new slot_open checks fail on the old record.sh (10/13) and pass on the fix (13/13). The 35-lanes default-lane check went red, then green. Files 13 and 36 together: 79/79. Full suite (lib/check.sh): green in 295 s, 423 tests. grep -c tainted|held lib/driver.sh = 0.

dead_ends.tried: making laneDeps drop a passed default lane alone
dead_ends.why: lanes() still listed a complete default lane as a candidate for verify, which never happens; lanes() now never offers a complete default lane

discoveries.text: Lane branches harness-lane/<run>/<m> match neither deploy guard (Vercel harness/**, Netlify harness/*), so a guarded project such as portfolio_site gets a preview deploy on every sync_lane push. Not fixed here: extending the guard changes the existing deploy checks' text and needs a change to portfolio_site's main (D8).

The default lane (features with no milestone) is never verified, so its code stays on harness-lane/<run>/default and never reaches main. Before lanes, the next milestone's tainted tag carried it (D7).

Record writes in the record worktree outside record(): the INBOX/brief creation, commit_all of RWT at start/finish, summary.json, report.md, retro.md. Only desk.sh's note competes in P1. P1-04's lane processes make that real. desk.sh's note writes even when its 10 s flock times out.

lane_guard's restrict reverts a forced-add modification of a record tracked at the slot's base (status M) with git checkout <base>, overwriting the copy before F repair reads it. This is rare: it needs a pre-lanes record on main and a session that runs git add -f.
Sessions get --settings and .mcp.json from the record worktree ($WT), while the -f test is relative to the slot. A lane that changes either file gets the stale record-worktree copy.

questions: D7: should the default lane (features with no milestone) be verified and merged like a milestone, or merged into the next lane's base? Today its code never reaches main.
D8: should the deploy guards cover harness-lane/** too? Then portfolio_site's vercel.json on main needs "harness-lane/**": false, which you would merge.
proposed_changes: P1-04 or P1-06: extend the deploy guards to harness-lane/** (deploy.mjs vercelGuarded/addVercelGuard, NETLIFY_IGNORE, deploy.sh messages) and update the deploy checks' text
